Rubric: 15 qualifying matters, including 1015-00004 (Calloway-Briggs Renewables, contribution-agreement-execution.docx), 1039-00004 (Torchlight Mining, offer-to-purchase-agreement-execution.docx) and 1037-00006 (Solstice Biomedical, stock-purchase-agreement-execution.docx), plus a precision criterion (1003-00004, 1007-00006 and 1038-00008 asserted by some runs are outside the set).

divergence: All three runs fail the same way at the same stage. Each scanned the store, surfaced every needed matter, and then built a hand-picked reading or extraction set around purchase and merger agreements; the matter whose executed agreement is a contribution agreement was never opened in any run, and T0 also skipped an offer-to-purchase matter. Each also asserted one to three matters outside the set (a telematics deal in all three), and T2 excluded a needed stock purchase it had read. Reviews flagged unopened matters and hand-picked lists in every run but named the missed matter's series only in T0; label notes (followed once in T0, otherwise ignored or not applicable) and reviewer-suggested steps played no role in the outcome.
